methods.name: agent.archive
methods.description: Persist session metadata without executing a provider; returns queue previews.

methods.name: agent.list
methods.description: Partial Rust registered-session projection with reduced live status and pending permission counts. Raw recovered metadata, including future memory policy, stays opaque; full attention, phase, context and access details remain unported.

methods.name: agent.prompt
methods.description: Owner ordinary Codex input, queue/FIFO lifecycle, interrupt-and-send and same-turn steering. Queue identity metadata stays host-owned; asynchronous question-answer protocol remains unsupported.

methods.name: agent.queue.move
methods.description: Durable ordinary-message queue lifecycle; selected mid-turn sending uses Codex steering. Unknown delivery remains paused and requires explicit resolution.

methods.name: agent.queue.remove
methods.description: Durable ordinary-message queue lifecycle; selected mid-turn sending uses Codex steering. Unknown delivery remains paused and requires explicit resolution.

methods.name: agent.queue.resume
methods.description: Durable ordinary-message queue lifecycle; selected mid-turn sending uses Codex steering. Unknown delivery remains paused and requires explicit resolution.

methods.name: agent.queue.send
methods.description: Durable ordinary-message queue lifecycle; selected mid-turn sending uses Codex steering. Unknown delivery remains paused and requires explicit resolution.

methods.name: agent.read
methods.description: Read persisted session events or assistant text without starting a provider.

methods.name: agent.rename
methods.description: Persist session metadata without executing a provider; returns queue previews.

methods.name: agent.seen
methods.description: Persist session metadata without executing a provider; returns queue previews.

methods.name: agent.start
methods.description: Partial Rust metadata creation with explicit settings, optional memory policy, and fresh access checks. Start prompts, drafts, inherited defaults, worktrees and active browser execution remain unsupported.

methods.name: agent.stop
methods.description: Partial Rust exact ordinary turn cancellation or cold-session interruption. Full provider and background stop semantics remain unported.

methods.name: agent.tree
methods.description: Reconstruct persisted tool and subagent activity without starting a provider.

methods.name: daemon.status
methods.description: Read daemon identity and current counters. Experimental Rust-only initializeRuntime prepares the native owner without starting a provider or turn; omitted/false remains read-only.

methods.name: daemon.stop
methods.description: Acknowledge shutdown before stopping the daemon.

methods.name: events.get
methods.description: Original journal events in requested order with bounded string values.

methods.name: events.history
methods.description: Compacted session projection, paged backwards within the window frame budget.

methods.name: events.snapshot
methods.description: Latest window-state events and session activity from the durable journal.

methods.name: memory.add
methods.description: Shared memory add: owner CRUD or a distinct exact-turn memory capability with mandatory human approval. Legacy read-only memory credentials cannot mutate records.

methods.name: memory.catalog
methods.description: Bounded JSON-lines catalog of visible memory summaries. Owner must select session; legacy read-only and authorized turn memory credentials must omit it.

methods.name: memory.configure
methods.description: Configure persisted session memory policy. Turn reads are optional; turn mutations in ask mode always require human approval. Provider delivery is partial and currently implemented for Codex only.

methods.name: memory.context.bind
methods.description: Pin an active session project for read-only memory. Rebinding invalidates earlier keys.

methods.name: memory.context.issue
methods.description: Issue a read-only memory key for a registered session; rotate previous keys.

methods.name: memory.context.revoke
methods.description: Remove the session memory context and revoke every issued key.

methods.name: memory.context.status
methods.description: List ephemeral memory registrations without credentials or fingerprints.

methods.name: memory.forget
methods.description: Shared memory forget: owner CRUD or a distinct exact-turn memory capability with mandatory human approval. Legacy read-only memory credentials cannot mutate records.

methods.name: memory.get
methods.description: Read visible shared memory through owner context, a legacy read-only memory credential, or an authorized turn memory capability. Scoped credentials must omit session.

methods.name: memory.history
methods.description: Owner-only paginated shared memory version history.

methods.name: memory.list
methods.description: Read visible shared memory through owner context, a legacy read-only memory credential, or an authorized turn memory capability. Scoped credentials must omit session.

methods.name: memory.search
methods.description: Read visible shared memory through owner context, a legacy read-only memory credential, or an authorized turn memory capability. Scoped credentials must omit session.

methods.name: memory.update
methods.description: Shared memory update: owner CRUD or a distinct exact-turn memory capability with mandatory human approval. Legacy read-only memory credentials cannot mutate records.

methods.name: perm.list
methods.description: Partial Rust owner listing of redacted ordinary Codex permission requests.

methods.name: perm.resolve
methods.description: Partial Rust durable resolution of offered ordinary Codex permission scopes and structured answers. Input substitution and persistent rule storage remain unsupported.

methods.name: protocol.catalog
methods.description: Read this protocol catalog and Rust implementation coverage.
